City of Encinitas
Regular City Council Meeting - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, AUGUST 19, 2020 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Oral Communications will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Oral Communication items will be referred to the City Manager either for resolution by administrative action or placement on a future agenda.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
*If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the July 10, 2020 Special Meeting and Closed Session, August 3, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session and August 5, 2020 Special Meeting-Closed Session. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2020-08-19 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Allsup
Approve the Warrants.
2020-08-19 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
2019 State Homeland Security Grant in the amount of $38,189 for the Purchase of 800 MHz Replacement Radios. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Jimenez
1) Accept $38,189 in federal funds from a 2019 State Homeland Security Program (SHSP) grant awarded to the City of Encinitas for the purchase of 800 MHz radios; and 2) Authorize the Fire Chief, or his designee, to sign and submit the required California Governor's Office of Emergency Services Fiscal Year 2019 Grant Program Standard Assurances.
2020-08-19 Item 08C State Homeland Security Grant Award Acceptance
8D.
Authorization to Purchase Janitorial Supplies from WAXIE Sanitary Supply. Contact Person: Senior Management Analyst Wilson
That City Council authorize participation in the City of Tucson, Arizona Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies national cooperative purchasing contract with Network Services Company and WAXIE Sanitary Supply (WAXIE) in a total amount not to exceed $250,000 for the term July 1, 2020 through May 31, 2025.
2020-08-19 Item 08D Janitorial Supplies Contract
8E.
Introduction of City of Encinitas Ordinance 2020-14 prohibiting jumping or diving from bridges and beach stairway accesses into the ocean or waterways in the City of Encinitas. Contact Person: Lifeguard Captain Giles
Introduce Ordinance 2020-14 entitled “An Ordinance of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending Chapter 8.08 of the Encinitas Municipal Code Prohibiting Jumping and Diving from Public Structures into the Ocean and Waterways.”
2020-08-19 Item 08E Bridge Jumping Ordinance
8F.
Resolution 2020-62 Approving Continuing Appropriations for Unspent Fiscal Year 2019-20 Appropriations to Fiscal Year 2020-21. Contact Person: Finance Manager Gallup
Staff recommends that the City Council adopt Resolution Number 2020-62, approving continuing appropriations requests identified in Attachment 1 of the agenda report.
2020-08-19 Item 08F Continuing Appropriations Agenda Report
8G.
Designation of a voting delegate and voting delegate-alternate for the League of California Cities (LCC) Annual Conference, October 7-9, 2020. Contact Person: Executive Assistant to Mayor and City Council Clisby
City Council adopt Resolution 2020-69 designating Council Member Mosca to represent the City of Encinitas as a voting delegate and Council Member Hinze as voting delegate-alternate at the LCC Annual Conference to be held October 7-9, 2020.
2020-08-19 Item 08G LCC Voting Delegate
8H.
Adoption of the City of Encinitas Cost Allocation Plan for FY 2020-21 and 2021-22. Contact Person: Finance Manager Huang
Adopt the Cost Allocation Plan (CAP) and authorize those charges to non-general fund programs and services as identified in Attachment 1 of the agenda report.
2020-08-19 Item 08H Cost Allocation Plan
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
PROCEDURES FOR PUBLIC HEARINGS ON APPEALS (ITEM 10A): New information such as documents, exhibits, letters, photos, charts, diagrams, videos, etc., WILL NOT be considered by the City Council if presented at this meeting. All material must have been submitted to the City Clerk no less than 7 calendar days prior to this hearing
10.
ACTION ITEMS Public Comments will be accepted as outlined above under New Public Comment Procedures. Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
10A.
Public hearing to consider an appeal of the Planning Commission's denial of a Major Use Permit Modification, Design Review Permit Modification, Parcel Map Waiver and Coastal Development Permit to modify a previously approved 25-unit timeshare hotel constructed in two phases with associated landscape/site improvements and a temporary construction trailer. The project also includes a request to consolidate three existing legal lots into one parcel. CASE NUMBER: MULTI-002886-2017, SUB-002905-201, USE-002887-2017, DR-002888-2017 & CDPNF-002889-2017 (17-205 MUPMOD/DRMOD/PMW/CDP); APPLICANT: Surfer's Point, LLC; APPELLANT: Surfer's Point, LLC; LOCATION: 100 & 2000 Carlsbad Boulevard (APNs: 216-042-01 & 05).
Contact Person: Principal Planner Colamussi
Approve the appeal, set aside the decision of the Planning Commission, and adopt attached Resolution No. 2020-65 (Attachment CC-1), or as modified by the City Council, to approve the project. At City Council's discretion, this action may include the proposed exterior modifications to the east building elevations provided to the Planning Commission via a memo dated June 18, 2020.

Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
